content.text: No non-solicitation, no-hire, or employee-inducement covenant appears anywhere in the Agreement — the absence itself meets our preferred position.

input.quote: 15.9 Entire Agreement; Amendments. This Agreement, together with the Correspondence and the Exhibits hereto and thereto, contains the entire understanding of the Parties with respect to the collaboration and the licenses granted hereunder.
input.rationale: Searches for "solicit", "hire", "induce", "employ or engage" and a full read of the GENERAL PROVISIONS article (sec-p0605) and the representations/covenants articles turned up no non-solicitation, no-hire or employee-inducement covenant; the only hits for "solicited"/"employee" relate to committee input, FTE definitions, confidentiality recipients, debarment covenants and indemnitee definitions. The integration clause confirms the Agreement is the entire understanding, so no non-solicit binds Sanofi from a superseded instrument (the prior Confidentiality Agreement is expressly superseded). This matches our preferred position of no non-solicit on the Customer, so no redline is warranted.
